final: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), shares AS (SELECT link_to_major, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM major_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), selected AS (SELECT s.member_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(member_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM selected
